scenes.stage_direction: Victor's commands meet increasingly specific questions he cannot answer. His uncertainty must not be played as proof Ethan is safe.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: He answered everything except the request for fresh proof.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: That does not tell us Ethan is safe. It tells us Victor cannot show me.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: He has contacted Kellan. They are looking for leverage against each other.

metadata.evidence_summary: Victor cannot verify what he still claims to control.
